description: Get direct club booking information for a course returned by search_courses, find_nearby_courses, or build_golf_trip. Returns the course's own online booking URL when on file for an open public course, along with its Stymie course-page link, official website, and pro shop phone. Stymie does not check live tee-time slot inventory, sell tee times, or charge a booking fee.

slug.description: Canonical Stymie course URL or full_slug returned by a course lookup
